description: This file defines the TranslationManager class in Drupal, which manages multiple translators for string translation, including adding, sorting, and translating strings with support for multiple languages.

classes.name: TranslationManager
classes.description: A class that manages a chain of translators for string translation, supporting priority-based sorting and translation retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TranslationManager with a default language.

methods.name: addTranslator
methods.description: Adds a translator to the chain with a specified priority.

methods.name: sortTranslators
methods.description: Sorts the translators based on priority.

methods.name: getStringTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves a translation for a string in a specified language using the chain of translators.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Returns a TranslatableMarkup object for a string.

methods.name: doTranslate
methods.description: Performs the actual translation of a string with options, considering language code and context.

methods.name: formatPlural
methods.description: Creates a PluralTranslatableMarkup object for plural translations.

methods.name: setDefaultLangcode
methods.description: Sets the default language code for translations.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all translators in the chain.
